notes.title: MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE IS LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/9a1cac6c4f65a0515861069ce2a03e7b9d0ae6e3.png[/img]
Hey everyone! We’ve just released a massive update that expands the world of Genopanic, adds new features, and gives completionists even more reasons to dive back in.

And yes — Genopanic is now available on Nintendo Switch and PlayStation, alongside PC (Steam)! 🎮

🔁 Backtracking is now available!
Use the brand-new pneumatic portal system to return to previously visited locations. Revisit old zones, uncover hidden paths, and chase every last secret. Perfect for explorers and achievement hunters!

💎 Collect belomorium crystals to boost your health
A new collectible has entered the lab — belomorium crystals. Each one increases your max health, helping you survive deeper into the facility and tougher encounters.

🧬 Unlock the best ending by completing the game 100%
Find all GMOs and crystals, and you’ll unlock a brand-new ending. More story, more revelations — no spoilers, but it’s definitely worth it.

🎬 More cutscenes, new lore, and extra dialogues
We've added fresh cutscenes, character interactions, and in-world notes to make the story more immersive and the lab even weirder.

🛠 Tons of fixes and polish
Bug fixes across multiple zones;

Better performance and stability;

Smoothed animations and platforming.

Thanks for all your support — and don’t forget: you can now play Genopanic on console too!

notes.title: Steam Deck Verified!✅
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/94f020f8c87affaf3796010cae53679795fc8a45.png[/img]
[h2]Genopanic is now fully Verified for Steam Deck!
[/h2]

This means that Steam Deck owners can enjoy the game without any limitations or performance issues. The verification ensures that all aspects of the game, including controls, interface, and performance, work optimally on this portable platform.
We are excited to offer our players a high-quality gaming experience on Steam Deck and thank everyone for their support!

notes.title: Now with Steam Trading Cards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/b77966aa52b3da6aa5c7dd024940fa005c132987.png[/img]
[h2]Dear Space Adventurers!
[/h2]

We are excited to announce that Genopanic now features [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b]! You can earn them by playing the game and trading with friends. Collect the complete set to craft a unique badge that you can proudly display on your Steam profile. Each badge will reward you with random drops of emoticons and backgrounds.

[h3]Now you can decorate your Steam profile with:
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Regular badge (5 levels)
[*] Foil badge (1 level)
[*] 3 profile backgrounds
[*] 10 emoticons
[/list]
Enjoy playing and badge crafting!

[h3]How to Collect Steam Trading Cards
[/h3]Play Genopanic to receive cards. Half of the card set drops during gameplay, and the remaining cards can be obtained by trading with other players on the Community Market.

[h3]How to Craft a Badge
[/h3]Once you have collected a full set of cards, you can craft them into a game badge. Badges can be crafted by accessing the Badges tab on your Steam profile. There are 5 levels of a regular badge and one foil badge available.

During badge crafting, you'll receive random rewards such as emoticons and backgrounds.

[h3]Follow our official channels and connect with other adventurers:
[/h3]
🐦 Genopanic Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/genopanic]https://twitter.com/genopanic[/url]
💬 Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/s8JxbUZCFD]https://discord.gg/s8JxbUZCFD[/url]
📩 Email: genopanic@mobirate.com


[h3]Happy gaming![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1984190

notes.title: Demo big update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/a8a3d924d7c7fa9b695374797b5c2af5a8717dbe.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hello, astronauts![/b][/h2]

Our team has made significant improvements to the core elements of the game and is ready to present a new demo version. The list provided below will introduce you to the coolest changes that will make your adventure even more fun and thrilling.

[list]
[*] The game's main menu has become even more beautiful, convenient, and intuitive. Now, even in low-gravity conditions, you can easily and quickly find the item you need.
[*] An interface has been added for the portable assistant P.E.S. (OS). It provides instant access to inventory, task list, message list, and the space station mini-map. We wanted to add the ability to listen to music and watch TV shows, but thought that you might get distracted and lost.
[*] Significant improvements have been made to the sound design. The sounds of locations, various types of weapons, and equipment have become more realistic for total immersion. We are sure that the updated enemy shrieks and character voices will not leave anyone indifferent.
[*] Speaking of characters, get ready to meet VOLGA - a bold and mischievous artificial intelligence of the space station that… ahem… will introduce you to the first dangerous boss - the loader robot KAMA.
[*] For those who love to search for secret rooms, there's a pleasant surprise - a fog of war that disappears with a mystical sound as you enter the room. But be careful, as the fog may hide not only rewards but dangers too.
[*] Another interesting addition is the developers' room. This is a bonus location where you can go through a real training simulation, test different types of weapons and equipment for passing laboratory tests. Try to collect all the hidden crystals.
[*] Please read the new messages carefully. You will encounter them in the most unexpected places. They will gradually reveal the mystery of what's happening on the station and introduce you to the game world.
[*] We must also mention that LAIK is now more emotional. He will be joyful, angry, and even scared, depending on the events around him. Don't scold him if he acts smart during training - it's just his character. In reality, he's cute and you'll befriend him.
[*] Chongus will reappear in the game and Monkat will flash by several times. You ask who they are? We won't answer, will just smile mysteriously, and suggest you play to find the answers to all your questions yourself.
[*] The bug clean-up is ongoing. The old bugs have been squashed and, to our knowledge, no new ones have snuck in.
[*] Rejoice, controller users! The game is now more convenient for you, with control tips matched to your controller buttons. Now, both handheld and console play are a breeze.
[*] Ultra-wide monitor users, we've got you covered! Enjoy a wider, more immersive experience with our new support feature.
[*] And good news for Steamdeck users, we now support this platform as well! Get ready for an optimized experience.
[/list]

We hope that you will get the most out of the game. We look forward to your feedback on social media.
Thank you for your attention!

notes.title: DEVLOG #2
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello, Explorers!
[/b][/h2]
The Space Station development team is in touch. 
In the last few weeks we have improved some of the existing animations and added some new ones. Let's take a closer look at the main changes.
In one of the previous posts we have already demonstrated the animation of jumping and running in the game. As you can see we have made it smoother and more enjoyable.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/c21110e1ef61d3d86e6a3f133842971f6e894592.gif[/img]

In addition the dash animation has been improved. This ability will allow the player to jump long distances and jump over dangerous traps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/b0094a773f543f8ae70de0256baf689708f53136.gif[/img]

We also finished work on the animation of interaction with objects. The player will have to solve interesting puzzles and use some items to advance to the next level.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/4b2052f1058c957a4c83b310705abf476a8056af.gif[/img]

As a bonus we’d like to show the first secret experiments with a gravity gun. Soon we will tell you more about other types of weapons in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/0aaf0c284c73ec6d51e29a4ab71406caa4a0aec6.gif[/img]
Add the game to your wishlist, join our [url=http://discord.gg/nNbGs2HPeQ]Discord server [/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Space_Station/]Reddit [/url] to communicate with developers and players.
[b]See you soon![/b]

notes.title: DEVLOG #1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello, Explorers! How's it going?[/b]
[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/6570b710e01a54f4fec27e91267ffad71238b3a8.gif[/img]

The Space Station development team is in touch. Yes, there is no news from us for a long time, but it doesn't mean we spend the summer on the beach with a cocktail. During the last month our game became much better and we are thrilled to tell you about the most interesting changes. Let's take a closer look at the new content!

[previewyoutube=1MDM_X2-QJM;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see we've added new character animations in order to improve the game dynamics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/5d082b7713fa77a00217913d001bf0aec124df47.gif[/img]


Dash is a new ability that allows you to jump over long distances. It’s the first such useful ability, but not the last one. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/ea1298149d4c36e17766449c1f90e0483069f43d.gif[/img]

At the same time, we are working on the new locations - 150 rooms are ready with a million more well on the way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/1e3c2ca28ae3abc58bdd7223efd209e94e6bd764.png[/img]

Our artists keep inventing new enemies and experimenting with skins and suits. They are amazing, aren’t they? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/d63af9aaba312f989449419471516a7849dfe9e2.png[/img]

In the future we will add more content and tell you about it in the upcoming posts. Add the game to your wishlist and join our [url=https://discord.gg/s8JxbUZCFD]Discord server[/url] to communicate with developers and players. See you soon! 
[url=https://discord.gg/s8JxbUZCFD][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42409305/de0aef9416505a8ea12338cf3aa77117f3f811c3.gif[/img][/url]
